Methodology

This adapter reads the public LMArena leaderboard payload, keeps the current top models on the text/overall board ranked by community Elo from head-to-head human votes, and stores daily StoryOps snapshots so the skyline replays how the arena standings move over time.

Observed 24 LMArena text/overall entries at 2026-08-05T07:01:00.333Z; snapshot leaderboard-sets/public/leaderboards/text-overall-style_control/leaderboard-snapshots/latest.
